title: Charts: a pie or donut with six or more slices repeats colours — the default palette is the five --chart-1..5 theme vars, taken modulo 5
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Found by the hotcrm lane while re-capturing screenshots for hotcrm#2605 (PR hotcrm#2613) on @objectstack 18.5.0: a 6-slice donut on the Sales dashboard draws the first and sixth slices in the same colour, so the legend cannot tell them apart. Read in code on objectstack `main` fc5913e117.

## Why, in code

- `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` ~2449: `getPalette()` falls back to five entries, `hsl(var(--chart-1))` … `--chart-5`. Slices take `palette[index % palette.length]` (~1321, ~1389, ~2303, ~3041).
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx` ~44: `CHART_COLORS` is the same five.
- No `--chart-6` or later is defined in `ui/packages`.

## Asked

A categorical chart with more categories than the palette never reuses a colour for two visible slices: extend the theme palette (and its dark-mode twin), or derive further distinct shades, or group the tail into "Other". The authored `colors` prop keeps winning.

## Done when

A 6- to 10-slice pie or donut draws every slice in a distinct colour in light and dark themes.
